title: [CLM-3] Sequencer, an IO, can map its streams to Spaces, contrary to S1 and the Space-anonymity cl
description: Review finding CLM-3: Sequencer, an IO, can map its streams to Spaces, contrary to S1 and the Space-anonymity claim (lens CLM). Location: spec/14-jmap.md:193; ARCHITECTURE.md:61, 86-88, 157-160. Fix: 14.4.6 states "its operator can associate its streams with those Spaces", which is outside §5 (S6) and contradicts §5 item 6's anonymity-set claim. The mitigation in 14.4.6 is only advisory. Full text: notes/review/CLM-verified.md and notes/review/CLM.md.
